turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Hyderabad?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Gupta. Who is this calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, my name is Rohan from Global Tech Solutions. I am calling regarding the part-time data optimization work you expressed interest in online.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, I remember clicking something, but I am not sure how it works. Is it really easy?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Very easy sir, you just like some videos and we pay you. In fact, your account already shows a profit of twelve thousand rupees from the trial tasks.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand? Really? How do I get this money in my bank?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why I called. To activate the withdrawal portal, you just need to pay a small security deposit of two thousand rupees first.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, why should I pay money to get my own profit?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a standard verification fee for tax purposes, Mr. Gupta. Once you pay, the full amount will be credited instantly.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know, this sounds a bit strange. Let me ask my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this offer expires in one hour. Please just send the payment via UPI now so you don't lose your bonus.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am getting very confused now, please give me some time.
